verified_metadata.title: Wavelet Score-Based Generative Modeling
verified_metadata.journal: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
verified_metadata.abstract: Wavelet factorization conditions fine coefficients on coarser scales, controls score ill-conditioning and gives linear-in-image-size sampling complexity under stated assumptions.
verified_metadata.comment: NeurIPS 2022 proceedings paper; DOI not asserted

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Florentin Guth、Simon Coste、Valentin De Bortoli、Stéphane Mallat；NeurIPS 2022，卷35；对应 arXiv:2208.05003。核验全文42页，含理论与补充实验；正文未列传统DOI。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: pixel-space score models在大图和临界随机场中为何需要很多reverse-SDE steps？能否用orthogonal wavelet multiscale factorization降低conditional score的Hessian condition number，使各尺度使用固定步数且总复杂度随pixels线性增长？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: forward diffusion把data逐渐高斯化，reverse integration稳定性受score Jacobian/Hessian最大与最小eigenvalues控制。scale-invariant distributions在pixel coordinates中低频/高频variance跨度随image size增长，造成stiffness。
wavelet transform本身不生成数据；WSGM把joint distribution分解为coarse marginal与逐尺度detail conditional，每一级各训练conditional score。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 使用orthogonal wavelet把x_j−1分为coarse x_j和detail coefficients，写p(x)=p(x_J)∏p(detail_j|x_j)。从最粗尺度开始，reverse SDE依次生成各scale details并inverse transform。

理论对Gaussian stationary processes证明renormalized wavelet conditional covariance在适当wavelet moments下condition number不随image size发散。实验覆盖φ4 critical fields、turbulence类physical processes与CelebA等natural images。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Figure 2比较pixel SGM与WSGM估计covariance随steps的误差；普通SGM达到固定误差所需N随L增长，而WSGM近乎size-independent，对应总linear complexity。
Figure 3在不同L的φ4 fields比较distribution statistics；Figure 4在固定16 steps下显示pixel SGM artifacts明显，WSGM生成更接近reference，且报告FID/物理统计改善。
线性complexity是每scale固定steps与network cost assumptions下的渐近结论；多尺度模型数量、训练成本、channel widths和硬件并行会影响实际wall-clock。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: Gaussian theorem不直接覆盖strongly non-Gaussian natural images；wavelet choice、boundary handling和conditional architecture会影响conditioning。逐尺度生成仍串行，超高分辨率的memory与training data成本未消失。
自然图像实验不是当代大型diffusion的统一SOTA比较；图像quality与physical-statistics benchmarks规模有限。wavelet factorization可能引入方向/translation artifacts。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 全文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.05003；会议PDF：https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2022/hash/03474669b759f6d38cdca6fb4eb905f4-Abstract-Conference.html。PDF SHA-256：4f3f173b8075a91c844d687ea87679400f1aaae2d7a96efb402366120e1ef77a。正文提供Algorithm 1与补充参数，未在主文列单一官方代码URL。

复现需固定wavelet family/levels、normalization、score architectures、SDE schedule、steps per scale、φ4 sampler、image preprocessing及FID/statistics实现。Evidence status: full-text verified theoretical/numerical study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–4 Figure 1与factorization；pp.4–7 conditioning theory；pp.7–10 Figures 2–4；pp.11–13局限；pp.14–42为proofs、Algorithm 1与额外实验。
